methods.label: International Wire Transfer (SWIFT)
methods.tagline: Bank-to-bank remittance to our Indian account
methods.instructions: Remit the invoice total in USD or EUR. Your bank converts to INR at the prevailing rate on credit. Email the SWIFT copy with your order number as the payment reference.

methods.label: Western Union
methods.tagline: Cash pickup / bank deposit to India
methods.instructions: Send the INR-equivalent amount via Western Union to the receiver above. Share the 10-digit MTCN, sender name and amount as your payment reference.

methods.label: Remitly
methods.tagline: Fast online remittance to Indian banks
methods.instructions: Add our beneficiary details in Remitly and send the INR-equivalent amount. Use your MediGram order number as the remittance reference and share the transaction ID.

methods.label: MoneyGram
methods.instructions: Send the INR-equivalent amount via MoneyGram. Provide the 8-digit reference number, sender name and amount as your payment reference.

methods.label: Wise (TransferWise)
methods.tagline: Low-fee transfer straight to our INR account
methods.instructions: Pay in your local currency — Wise converts to INR at the mid-market rate. Use your order number as the transfer reference.

methods.label: Bitcoin (BTC)
methods.instructions: Send the BTC equivalent of your invoice at the admin-set rate. Paste the transaction hash (TxID) as your payment reference. Confirmations required: 2.

methods.label: Ethereum (ETH)
methods.instructions: Send the ETH equivalent of your invoice at the admin-set rate. Paste the transaction hash as your payment reference.

methods.label: USDT (TRC-20)
methods.instructions: 1 USDT = 1 USD. Send the invoice total in USDT and paste the transaction hash as your payment reference.
